JOB SUMMARY**

PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk is seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Capital Project Procurement Officer. In this role, you will be responsible for sourcing, negotiating, and acquiring high-value equipment, machinery, construction services, and materials required for our large-scale capital expenditure (CAPEX) projects. You will collaborate closely with engineering, project management, and finance teams to ensure that all project acquisitions are completed on time, within budget, and in accordance with company quality standards and compliance regulations.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Manage the end-to-end procurement process for capital projects (CAPEX), including machinery, industrial equipment, construction works, and engineering services.
* Conduct market research, identify potential local and international suppliers, and manage vendor pre-qualification and evaluation processes.
* Prepare and issue Requests for Information (RFI), Requests for Proposal (RFP), and Requests for Quotation (RFQ).
* Lead commercial negotiations with vendors and contractors to secure the most competitive pricing, favorable payment terms, and robust service level agreements (SLAs).
* Draft, review, and finalize procurement contracts and purchase orders in alignment with legal and company guidelines.
* Monitor vendor performance, delivery schedules, and project milestones to ensure timely delivery of goods and services, mitigating any potential project delays.
* Collaborate with internal project managers, engineers, and finance departments to align procurement activities with project timelines and budget allocations.
* Maintain accurate procurement documentation, records, and reports for audit and compliance purposes.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or Civil), Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Minimum of 3–5 years of proven experience in procurement, specifically focusing on CAPEX and capital project sourcing, preferably within the manufacturing, agro-industrial, or food production sectors.
* Strong understanding of strategic sourcing, contract law, negotiation techniques, and project management principles.
* Familiarity with importing procedures, customs regulations, and international logistics is highly advantageous.
* Proficiency in using ERP systems (such as SAP) and Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel).
* Excellent communication, analytical, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with both internal stakeholders and external vendors.
* Fluency in English (both written and spoken) is required.
